english.title: Use a laden motor vehicle on a road with lateral projection exceeding 305mm
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) used on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), carrying a load which had

(A)_[a lateral projection]_
(B)_[lateral projections on either side]_

exceeding 305mm
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 82(2)(a) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
use on a road
a motor vehicle
with load with lateral projection(s)
projections on either side
exceeding 305mm.

english.notes:
(i) See regulation 82(2) for exceptions.
(ii) See offence wordings: H2549, H2550, H3056 and H3057 for excess width of laden vehicles.
(iii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iv) See also offence wordings: H2545 and H2546.
english.standardstatementoffacts:
At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant used **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..).
The vehicle was carrying a load which projected beyond its

(A)_[nearside ]_
(B)_[offside ]_
(C)_[sides]_

for a distance of **(..SPECIFY DISTANCE(S)..).
The maximum permitted projection was 305 millimetres.

welsh.welshlegislation: Yn groes i reoliad 82(2)(a) Rheoliadau Cerbydau Ffyrdd (Gwneuthuriad a Defnydd) 1986, adran 42 Deddf Traffig Ffyrdd 1988 ac Atodlen 2 Deddf Troseddwyr Traffig Ffyrdd 1988.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale if in respect of goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.

A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale in any other case.

Fixed penalty ticket - Fifty pounds.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
